quality_attributes.name: Security
quality_attributes.description: Protection of user information, credentials, biometric data and payment information against unauthorized access or disclosure, in line with ISO 27001.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit: S1 requires end-to-end encryption of user information between device and database; S3 requires the thumb impression to be flushed after login; S4 requires inactivity logout; the project description requires compliance with ISO 27001 and security of user data including payment information.
evidence: S1: 'user information is secured with an end-to-end encryption of information between user device and app database'
S3: 'The login module must flush out user thumb impression as soon as the user has been able to login.'
S4: 'after an inactivity of 15 minutes'
Project description: 'comply with the relevant security and data protection standards, such as ISO 27001'
Project description: 'ensure the security and privacy of user data, including payment information'

quality_attributes.name: Privacy and Regulatory Compliance
quality_attributes.description: Handling of personal data (registration data, location, usage history, biometric data, payment data) in compliance with GDPR, the Privacy Directive and local regulations (EU or China depending on location).
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit constraints in the project description. Applies to personal data collected in S1, biometric data in S3, payment data in S8 and retained usage history in S11/S13. The applicable jurisdiction is ambiguous (EU or China).
evidence: Project description: 'comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Privacy Directive'
Project description: 'comply with local regulations and standards, including EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'
S11: 'usage history up to last 3 months'

quality_attributes.name: Interoperability
quality_attributes.description: Ability to exchange information with external systems: a variety of third-party payment platforms (bank account, debit/credit card) and SMS/email delivery for verification codes and notifications.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit for payments (project description and S8). Strongly implied for messaging, since S2 requires sending codes via SMS or email and S9 requires notifying the biker.
evidence: Project description: 'compatible with a variety of third-party payment platforms to allow users to pay for the bike rental fee seamlessly'
S8: 'pay via their bank account or by their debit/credit card'
S2: 'verification code via an SMS or email'

quality_attributes.name: Portability (multi-client accessibility)
quality_attributes.description: The system's functionality must be accessible from both web and mobile devices.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit and repeated in the project description. Biometric login (S3) and code scanning/navigation (S6) depend on device capabilities, so behavior across client types matters.
evidence: Project description: 'available on web and mobile devices'
Project description: 'accessible through both web and mobile devices to maximize the availability of the service'

quality_attributes.name: Usability
quality_attributes.description: The application must be user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit in the project description; supported by user-facing functions such as proximity filtering (S5), navigation to the bike (S6) and expiry notification (S9).
evidence: Project description: 'user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders'
S6: 'App must help the biker to navigate to the available bike that they have selected.'

quality_attributes.name: Performance (timeliness of bike availability and location)
quality_attributes.description: Bike availability and location information must be updated and presented promptly, so that registered bikes disappear from the available list immediately and bikers see current bikes near them.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied: S7 states 'As soon as' a bike is registered it must be removed from the available list, and the project description requires tracking and displaying bike locations within a radius. No quantitative latency or throughput target is given.
evidence: S7: 'As soon as the bike is registered it must be removed from the list of available bikes.'
Project description: 'capable of tracking and displaying the location of available bikes within a 1000-meter radius'

quality_attributes.name: Availability
quality_attributes.description: The rental service should be available to riders when they want to use it.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied: the project description states the goal 'to maximize the availability of the service', though in the context of web and mobile access; no uptime target is given.
evidence: Project description: 'accessible through both web and mobile devices to maximize the availability of the service'

quality_attributes.name: Modifiability
quality_attributes.description: Ability to accommodate changes in payment methods/platforms and in regulatory requirements depending on deployment location.
quality_attributes.rationale: Strongly implied: S8 says cash is 'Currently' not supported; the project description requires compatibility with 'a variety' of payment platforms and compliance with EU or China standards depending on location.
evidence: S8: 'Currently cash payments are not supported.'
Project description: 'a variety of third-party payment platforms'
Project description: 'including EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'

quality_attributes.name: Sustainability (resource efficiency)
quality_attributes.description: The software should be designed to minimize its carbon footprint.
quality_attributes.rationale: Explicit constraint in the project description; it is not tied to any functional requirement and has no measurable target, so its architectural weight is limited.
evidence: Project description: 'designed to minimize the carbon footprint and promote sustainable mobility'
